verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an official npm-installed CLI built for agent use. It offers `--json` output with a stable schemaVersion/data/error envelope, a `doctor` diagnostic, and `init` to write skill files for Codex and Claude Code. Recorded hands-on probes confirm the binary runs, the device-code login is agent-drivable, offline guide and schema commands work, and arena commands were re-verified after a fix. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the authenticated hosted process/context commands (only keyless AUTH_REQUIRED refusals were observed), independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor-recorded probes.
